turns.text: quick q. my parents' printer driver is cursed. it installs fine then says offline every time. windows 11 laptop, wifi printer. ideas pls

Classic. 'Offline' after a clean install usually means the PC is talking to the wrong port. Try this:

1. Settings > Bluetooth & devices > Printers & scanners, remove every copy of the printer.
2. Print server properties (search 'Print Management' or run printui /s) > Drivers tab, remove the old driver package too.
3. Give the printer a static IP in your router, or at least note its current IP from the printer's network page.
4. Add the printer by IP: Add device > Add manually > TCP/IP address. Use the maker's full driver, not the generic one.
5. Restart the Print Spooler service (services.msc).

If it still says offline, check the port's SNMP setting and turn it off. That's a common culprit. Want a quick version for your phone?

lol yeah the duplicate copies are probably the mini boss. there are like four. i'm basically the unofficial IT for my parents' phones and printer. they live in a fourplex off vinca and i'm over here fixing things on a sunday

Four copies is definitely the boss's minions. Delete all of them first, then the driver package, otherwise Windows keeps respawning the broken one.

For the phone setup, what do you need: connecting it to the printer, or setting up printing from the phone? Tell me whether it's Android or iPhone and I'll give you exact steps.
android. need it to print from the phone too. also i gotta finish before my sunday night co-op game with my squad so tldr steps pls

TL;DR for Android:

1. Make sure the phone is on the same wifi as the printer.
2. Settings > search 'Printing' > Default Print Service: turn it on.
3. If your printer brand has a plugin (HP, Epson, Canon, Brother), install it from the Play Store and enable it under Printing.
4. Open a photo or PDF > Share > Print > pick the printer.
5. If it doesn't show up, tap Add printer > enter the printer's IP manually.

Do the PC first with the static IP, and the phone should find the printer right away. Good luck, and gg on the game later.
